s: a sixth-floor rooftop café with an unobstructed Marina Bay skyline view
w: Take the lift to level six of an unremarkable South Bridge Road office block and step out onto an open rooftop with an unobstructed sweep of the Marina Bay skyline -- the kind of view that would usually come with a hotel price tag. Specialty coffee and bakes served in a genuinely hidden-feeling perch above Clarke Quay.
_facts: Located at 50 South Bridge Rd, CMO Building, #06-00, Singapore 058682, accessed via lift to Level 6
Rooftop café with unobstructed views of the Marina Bay skyline
Open weekdays only (closed Saturday and Sunday)
Serves specialty coffee and baked goods, including Basque cheesecake
